;; D19 acceptance demonstration: the same mover using capture domains.
;; Variable j is the carried floor and v is the destination floor.

CLASS floor -.O

GOAL
Z

!1-

;; BEGIN MOVER
ROTATE_CMDS demo_move
 FOR g Rr
  ATOMIC j floor v floor
   !1j !1j [norotate]

   gv jg

   !1j !1v [norotate]

CMD demo_move_e
 FOR g Rr
  ATOMIC j floor v floor
   !1j

   v???g g???j

   !1j !1v

CMD demo_move_w
 FOR g Rr
  ATOMIC j floor v floor
   !1j

   g???v j???g

   !1j !1v
;; END MOVER
